scope: field bosses, gimmicks and counters, respawn, notes, two-day boss rematch gimmicks

checks.name: nine field bosses are installed on their original places with their original drop materials
victory drops the material, starts a 24-hour respawn, records notes; defeat can be retried at once
a wind-up ends the boss turn, is shown to the player and fires on the next turn
immunities, flying and air access: the Anemo Hypostasis
revival: the Anemo core can be broken in time, otherwise the boss stands up again
prisms halve damage and guard the Electro revival; pillars heal the Geo Hypostasis and take double Geo damage
Regisvine shells: the right element breaks them, a broken shell stuns and exposes the core, and it grows back
the Pyro Regisvine heat wave is an intentional unfair beat that heat gear answers
the Oceanid is untouchable; eight defeated forms win; flying forms land after they attack
the Primo Geovishap beam: shields cut it by 75% and two shields reflect it
the Cryo Hypostasis core breaks after four hits; the Ruin Serpent burrows and shows its head after a charge
two-day bosses get their rematch gimmicks only in voluntary challenges
every boss fight finishes on auto without errors or stalls
entrance and battle screens show boss info, notes, telegraphs and state
